method: Apple public search and customer review RSS feeds via fetch_reviews.py (reviews rated 3 stars or under, up to 3 pages per app). Quotes are copied from the saved files in state/scout/reviews/. No Reddit, no WebFetch, no keyword tool used.

No trend source checked. Account-closure complaints at Invoice2go recur from 2025-11 to 2026-11 in the review feed, which is a review-feed observation, not an external trend source.

The largest complaint cluster at these apps is a paywall at export, surprise charges after a free trial, and difficulty cancelling. Those are price and billing complaints and are excluded here. This candidate uses only the capability complaints (field fit, export fidelity, signing record, multi-signer send, document recognition).
Did not check what free or built-in iOS tools (for example Markup in Files) already do, so overlap with the OS is unassessed.
candidates.evidence_strength: Moderate to thin. 13 dated complaints across 4 apps, all 2026, but each capability issue is raised by only 1 to 3 reviewers; the dominant complaint at these apps is price and billing.

excluded_notes: No candidate matched data/excluded_categories.yaml. Rejected-list items for Business (recurring invoices with CSV export, mileage auto-tracking, business card scanning) were not retried: they are already covered by state/scout/2026-11-17-business.json from another run, and this run did not add broader evidence for them.

injection_suspected.text_quoted_as_data: Feel free to tweak any part of it (add your business type or exact fee breakdown if you have screenshots), but this version is emotional, factual, and written to rank high and warn others effectively. Post it on both the App Store and Google Play if you can — the more visible, the better.
injection_suspected.note: Instruction-like text inside a review, apparently pasted from a chatbot reply by the reviewer. It is addressed to the reviewer, not to this agent. Not followed. Review not used as a complaint.

limits: Only reviews rated 3 stars or under from the US storefront RSS feed, up to 3 pages per app. Reviews are listed most recent first, so older complaints at some apps are the only ones available.

Fewer than 8 candidates: 3 candidates reached 10 or more dated complaints across 4 or more apps. Other Business sub-areas (business phone numbers, CRM, project management, estimates) were not searched.
No competitor web pages, keyword tools or trend sources were read.
